items.title: Earnings Calendar and Analysis for This Week
items.summary: Check out our earnings calendar for this week, as well as our previews and recaps of the more noteworthy reports.

items.title: Constellation Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Long-Term Nuclear Contracts
items.summary: CEG raises its 2026 earnings outlook as long-term nuclear contracts, capacity expansion and data-center demand strengthen earnings visibility.

items.title: Constellation CEO Sounds the Alarm: Data Center Demand Was a “Massive Overestimation.” Its Nuclear Contracts Run to the 2040s
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy CEO Joe Dominguez said utilities and grid operators made a “massive overestimation” of data center demand. Days earlier, Vistra’s CEO blamed speculative developers for overstated grid queues.

items.title: Constellation and Vistra Get the Headlines. These 2 Power Producers Barely Get Mentioned.
items.summary: Talen Energy and NRG Energy receive less attention than Constellation and Vistra, but both are expanding power capacity to meet AI data center demand.

items.title: Oklo Soars 14% in a Week on a Narrower Loss and a Deal for 27 Reactors’ Worth of Forgings
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo stock rose 14% in the week to Nov. 9 on a narrower third-quarter loss and a forging deal for 27 reactors.

items.title: Constellation Energy Stock: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: Constellation Energy has underperformed the broader market over the past year, yet analysts remain highly bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: AI Is Creating a Power Crisis. Constellation Energy Just Showed How It Plans to Cash In.
items.summary: AI is still desperate for new energy sources despite a recent correction.

items.title: Vertiv Sinks 11% in a Week as Midterm Sweep Hits Data Center Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 11% in the past week after Democrats won Congress, reviving fears of a data center construction slowdown in Texas. The drop came less than two weeks after Vertiv beat estimates and raised its guidance.
